 Prayer:-

Criminal Orignal Petition filed under Section 482 of Cr.P.
 calling for the records pertaining to the case in S.C.No.69 of 2019  file of the Principal District Sessions Court, Ariyalur & District   the same as far as the petitioner is concerned.
 For Petitioner : Mr.C.Santhoshkumar  For Respondents : Mr.A.Damodaran  Additional Public Prosecutor  1 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis  Cr  ORDER
This Criminal Original Petition is filed to quash the complaint filed for the offences under Sections 466, 468, 474, 420, 511 and 328 of IPC and Sections 6, 24(1) of COTPA Act.

By on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150603329/
1 2.The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw this petition with libery to raise the grounds before the Trial Court.
He has also made an endorsement to that effect.
3.In view of the submission and endorsement made by the learned counsel, this Criminal Original Petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to raise the grounds before the Trial Court.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
